definitions.short: a pot ; also a thorn (as springing up rapidly); by implication, a hook
definitions.full: H5518. ciyr I. סִיר noun masculine Jer 1:13 and feminine 2Kin 4:38 pot (probably foreign word (Egyptian ?), Arabic a large water-jar Lane 1276is perhaps loan-word ; on Greek derivatives σιρός , σίρινος see Lewy Fremdw. 107 ); — ׳ס absolute 4:38 +, construct Exod 16:3 +; plural סִירֹת 38:3 , סִירוֺת 1Kin 7:45 +; suffix סִירֹתָיו Exod 27:3 , סִירֹתֵיכֶם Psa 58:10 ; — pot: 1. a. household utensil for boiling 2Kin 4:38-39 , 40 , 41 (twice in verse) ׳ס הַבָּשָׂר Exod 16:3 (P), Zech 14:21 ; ׳ס נָפוּחַ Jer 1:13 (compare נפח in vision), symbolic of Jerusalem Ezek 11:3 , 7 , 11 ; 24:3 , 6 ; figurative also Psa 58:10 (compare Che); in simile Micah 3:3 ; Job 41:23 ; Eccl 7:6 . b. ׳ס רַחְצִי Psa 60:10 my washing-pot , 108:10 . 2 pots used in sanctuary, Ezek 27:3 ; 38:3 (both P), 1Kin 7:40 (read סִירוֺת for כִּיִּרוֺת ᵑ0 , so Manuscripts of HCT ᵑ9 ᵐ5 Th Ke Klo Kmp Benz), 7:45 2Chr 4:11 , 16 ; 2Kin 25:14 = Jer 52:18 , also 52:19 ; 2Chr 35:13 ; Zech 14:20 . — Here belongs probably סִרָה in הַסִּרָה בּוֺר . II. [ סִיר ] noun [masculine] thorn, hook ( ᵑ7 id. ; compare סירם in Sabean proper name Hom ZMG xivi (1892), 532 ); — 1 plural סִירִים thorns , sign of desolation Isa 34:13 , a barrier Hosea 2:8 , on Nahum 1:10 see [ סָבַךְ ]; הַסּ ׳כְּקוֺל הַסִּיר תַּחַת Eccl 7:6 as the sound of thorns (crackling as they burn) under the pot . 2 plural סִירוֺת hooks Amos 4:2 (compare דּוּגָה below דגה ; || צִנּוֺת ; on relation of meanings see צֵן חוֺחַ, ). סָךְ , [ סֹךְ ], סֻכּוֺת סֻכָּה, see II. סכך .
definitions.rootNote: or (feminine) סִירָה ; or סִרָה ; (Jeremiah 52:18), from a primitive root meaning to boil up;
